why: Look across each row. The number of people in the third circle = people in the first circle minus people in the second circle (2-1=1, 3-1=2). In the last row 2-2=0, so the circle must be empty: option 3. Option 4 (two men) is tempting because the row starts with two men, but it breaks the count rule.
trick: In 3x3 grids of counted objects, test simple sums or differences along rows (col1 - col2 = col3).
